2026-03-04T16:03:09.5677835Z ## Phase 6: History Pruning
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5678441Z 
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5678901Z Prune old daily summary comments on the dashboard issue.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5679695Z 
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5679953Z ### Steps:
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5680815Z 1. Use the **github tool** to list ALL comments on the dashboard issue.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5682523Z 2. Filter to comments whose body starts with `## 📋 Health Check`. Never hide human comments.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5684122Z 3. Parse the date from each: `## 📋 Health Check — {date}`.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5685137Z 4. Apply retention:
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5686014Z    - Age ≤ 10 days → KEEP
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5687231Z    - 10 days < age ≤ 1 year → keep only the latest per ISO week, mark others for hiding
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5688533Z    - Age > 1 year → mark for hiding
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5689743Z 5. Use `hide-comment` safe output with reason `OUTDATED` for each marked comment.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5691119Z 6. Max 60 hides per run. Prioritize oldest if > 60.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5692234Z 7. Skip already-hidden comments and unparseable dates.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5693297Z 8. First run: skip pruning entirely.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5693861Z 
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5694103Z ---
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5694417Z

2026-03-04T16:03:09.5697465Z - No cache → first run, display "N/A" for deltas, note "First run."
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5698635Z - Body > 60k chars → apply size guard.
2026-03-04T16:03:09.5699645Z - Unparseable comment date → skip in pruning.
